aboutMe:
Web developer with over 10 years of experience creating scalable, functional digital solutions centered on user experience. Specialized in React and modern web application development, with a focus on technical quality, performance, and code maintainability.
I am passionate about designing intuitive, efficient interfaces and collaborating on challenging projects where I can add value through architecture, implementation, and continuous improvement.
I am looking to continue growing in innovative environments, contributing to the development of digital products with real impact while strengthening my expertise in React, Node.js, and high-performance software development.
